tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs bzhugs so// ༄༅// na ma ār+yā tā rā yai/ rnam mang sku yi bkod pa dpag med cing*// rnam dag gsung gi spros pa mtha' las 'das// rnam grol thugs mnga' grangs med 'gro ba'i skyabs// bcom ldan sgrol ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las gcig bsdus pa// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bcom ldan 'das ma la// snying nas cho nge drag po 'di 'debs so// dar cig chos kyi dbyings nas gsan du gsol// tshad med sdug bsngal chu bos yongs gang ba'i// srid pa'i rgya mtshor lhung ba'i 'gro ba kun// nga yis bde bar sgrol zhes dam bcas pa// de yi dus la bab bo bcom ldan ma// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs kun gyi mkhyen pa yis// nga yi rlabs chen spyod pa gzigs gyur te// nga la sgrol mar grags zhes zhal bzhes pa// de yi dus la bab bo= /khyod kyis spangs rtogs yon tan kun brnyes pa'i// sna tshogs thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa// mgon med 'gro ba'i don tu 'gyur grang na// de yi dus la bab bo= /gang gis khyod kyi mtshan tsam thos pa yi// skad cig gcig la nyam thag dbugs phyung ste// bde mchog byang chub nyid la reg ces thos// de yi dus la bab bo= /de phyir khyed kyis mkhyen brtse nus pa yis// ma rig dbang gis log pa'i lam zhugs te// mi zad sdug bsngal grong du myur 'gro ba'i// mtha' yas 'gro ba kun la bskyab tu gsol// khyad par lus dang srog la ltas med par// snying nas bdag la brtse ba'i drin can ma// sngon nas 'phags pa'i lam du rgyug gyur te// tshe 'di'i snang ba nub nas ring zhig lon// da lta gang na ci 'dra'i gzugs 'byung nas// ci za gang gyon skabs su byed pa yi// cha tsam blun po bdag gis ma shes so// myur mdzad thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// gshin rje'i skye bos lcags bsregs rab 'bar ba'i// sa gzhir bsgyel nas sna tshogs mtshon bsnun kyang*// brtol med bdag la skyob pa'i mthu ma mchis// myur mdzad khyed kyi thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol// gangs ri'i ljongs su lhag chen gyis gzir te// sha rus tshal pa du mar gas gyur kyang*// nyam chung bdag gis de la ci zhig bya// myur mdzad=

/bskal par zas skom dri tsam mi tshor zhing*// sred skom sdug bsngal drag pos gdung gyur kyang*// bdag gis cung zad phan par ma nus so// myur mdzad= /nges dang ma nges gnas su gcig la gcig /za zhing sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong gyur kyang*// bdag la skyob pa'i nus pa ma mchis so// myur mdzad= /gzhan yang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// mi sdug skye bo grangs med go bgos shing*// lag na sna tshogs mtshon cha mang thogs pas// sdang bar byed pa'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol// rab khros sdang ldan mig dag cher 'grad de// lce dang rnga ma ral pa bcas g.yo zhing*// mi bzad sgra sgrogs mche sder rnon po yis// 'tshe byed seng ge'i 'jigs las= /gang gi stobs kyis nags tshal kun 'joms shing*// rang gi mche ba rno dang sna la ni// mthong bas skrag byed mtshon cha rab thogs pa// glang chen khros pa'i= /phyogs gzhan du bas mun par khyer byed cing*// skar mda' 'khyug 'dra'i me stag rab 'phro bas// brtan g.yo ma lus thal bar sreg nus pa'i// me chen 'bar ba'i 'jigs las= /mi sdug mdog sngo drag po'i phud sgra sgrog /lus dang mche ba 'khyog po lce gnyis ldan// khros pa'i dug gis 'gro kun rlag byed pa'i// sbrul gdug sdang ba'i 'jigs las= /chags dang sdang ba'i sems ldan srin po'i gzugs// ji snyed mtshon chas gnas dang lam rnams su// mthu dang 'jab bus gzhan dag 'joms byed pa'i// khrel med chom rkun 'jig las= /brtse med rgyal po'i bka' yis pho nya 'gas// rkang lag dam bcings yun ring bkres skom gyi// gdung ba cher myong tha mar srog 'phrog pa'i// mi bzad zhags pa'i 'jigs las= /chu klung ji snyed rtag tu 'du ba'i gnas// shugs drag rlung gis bskyod pa'i rba rlabs can// ma rungs chu srin tshogs kyis yongs gang ba'i// rgya mtsho 'khrugs pa'i 'jig las= /mi sdug gzugs ldan 'jigs rungs gad rgyang sgrog

/rtsub pa'i sems 'chang lag gnyis mtshon chas brel// sha khrag la dga' phyogs kun khyab gyur pa'i// mi srun sha za'i 'jigs las= /'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa 'dre rgod kyis gzir ram// mtshon gyis gtses pa'i zug rngu drag po yis// smre sngags cher 'don nye du'i ngor bltas kyang*// phan med srog gcod nad las= /brgya byin khros pa'i bka' nyan gdug pa can// sna tshogs mdangs ldan dag gis rab 'bar ba'i// mtshon cha'i char gyis 'gro rnams 'joms byed pa'i// mi bzad dbang po'i 'jigs las= /'tsho ba 'dod pas tsha grang bzod dka' ba// dpag med myong zhing gzhan gyi ngor bltas te// gcom bu'i tshig dag brjod kyang bdag gi don// re chad dbul ba'i 'jigs las= /srid par 'ching ba'i lcags sgrog nyid yin kyang*// ma rig dbang gis yid gcugs dga' ma la// 'dod pa'i bde dang bral ba'i gdung ba gang*// dmyal mer lhung 'dra de las= /khro ba'i dbang gyur gshin rje ji bzhin du// gsod la dga' bas 'khor mang bsdus byas te// nyes med gzhan srog 'phrog phyir thabs brtson pa'i// mi bdag 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs las= /gang tshe lha min lha yi dpal la rtsod// de dag gzhom phyir lha dbang rab khros pas// 'bar ba'i rdo rje mtha' yas 'phang gyur te// nyes med 'joms pa'i 'jigs las= /'bras bu rgyu yi rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir// sngon dus gzhan gyi bsam pa bzlog byas pas// tshe 'dir ngal brgyas bsgrubs kyang re ba'i don// phyir zhing nyams pa'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol// mdor na bcom ldan khyod kyi thugs rje yis// khrel med bdag gi drin can pha ma rnams// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag rab spangs te// myur du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mdzod// ces rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma la gsol ba 'debs pa thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ban+de dpal grub kyis e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o//

gong gi tshigs bcad rnams spro na lam du 'don par 'dod na bskyab tu gsol zhes pa'i gnas su thar bar shog ces skyar bar bya'o// maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
